issue.title: Evaluate concrete NEMESIS and W33 mechanisms for the native geometric model

milestone.title: Native Rust geometric intelligence — conversation, memory, reasoning and coding
milestone.description:
Build useful local geometric intelligence in Rust: preparation, learning, artifacts and inference. Prime/ordered-n-let addresses, fixed zeta phases, R4/S3/H4 state, exact Z[phi]/orientation, typed paired-H4/icosian geometry and UOR identity remain primary. Offline Rust training may use matrix multiplication; serving uses learned bounded geometric routing/state and integer/table operators, with no hidden dense transformer or response provider.

Immediate owner-adopted sequence (2026-09-05): #1137 role-aware shared source selection/commit -> #1138 learned exact relations beyond the raw window -> #1139 selective geometric access at complete cost -> #1140 learned typed operator composition for conversation and Rust reasoning. #973 is the model parent; #820 is the programme tracker. Only the earliest unmet step is immediate work. An accepted behavioral handoff, not mere issue closure, unlocks the next step.

Canonical plan and responsibility consolidation: https://github.com/UOR-Foundation/uor-r4/blob/main/docs/integration/project-track.md
Actual implementation/artifacts/results: https://github.com/UOR-Foundation/uor-r4/blob/main/docs/integration/current-state.md

After the four accepted handoffs: broader #954 correctness, #955 reasoning, #962 conversation/service, #1088 coding/workspace, #963 optimization, #964 guarantees/publication and #965 integrated qualification/release. Both alpha capability groups remain unqualified. Historical positive, negative and unavailable results retain their exact scope.

One task/agent; budget-friendly complete cycles and cumulative accounting. Necessary storage increases are preauthorized and recorded; no deletion or paid compute. Protected PR delivery remains required. Planning changes do not establish model capability or geometric advantage.

issue.body:
## Superseded by #973 and its active build issue — 2026-09-05

NEMESIS/W33/SpiralCore or other mechanisms remain eligible for a concrete observed problem. Broad survey work is deferred; prior evidence remains preserved.

Closed as **not planned in this separate tracker**, not as completed capability. The owner requested a clean immediate plan; all outstanding responsibilities are explicitly reassigned in the canonical consolidation map. Historical issue text and results remain below.

The owner-adopted [immediate build sequence](https://github.com/UOR-Foundation/uor-r4/blob/main/docs/integration/project-track.md#immediate-build-sequence) is **#1137 -> #1138 -> #1139 -> #1140**, under #973. Complete accepted behavioral handoffs before broader programme expansion. The [current implementation](https://github.com/UOR-Foundation/uor-r4/blob/main/docs/integration/current-state.md) owns artifact/results; a closed negative is not a passed prerequisite. Rust learning may use matrix multiplication; serving remains bounded learned prime/zeta/R4 state/routing and integer/table operators. Historical evidence is preserved below.

<details>
<summary>Historical issue scope and evidence (preserved; superseded for scheduling)</summary>

## Current authority — native geometric AI recovery (2026-09-04)

The [canonical plan](https://github.com/UOR-Foundation/uor-r4/blob/main/docs/integration/project-track.md) owns the native Rust prime/zeta/R4 architecture; the [current implementation](https://github.com/UOR-Foundation/uor-r4/blob/main/docs/integration/current-state.md) records the changing work and executed evidence. Both conversation/memory and coding/reasoning are alpha requirements. Rust training may use matrix multiplication; serving must execute learned geometric operators through bounded route/state/integer-table operations. The seven primary roles are prime/ordered-context identity, fixed-zeta phases, R4/S3/H4 causal state, exact Z[phi]/orientation, the typed paired-H4/icosian bridge, learned geometric operators and UOR canonical identity. Their architecture remains required wherever integration or useful contribution is pending.

**Current objective:** Keep this supporting research lane available for a concrete implementation question: identify an original mathematical object, the actual Rust seam, a proposed mapping and a useful discriminating check. Inspect and attribute source material, preserve its corrections and license boundary, and avoid transferring a proof or capability claim between unlike geometries. Primary UOR prime/zeta/R4/H4/paired mechanisms are part of the project itself; external NEMESIS/W33 material may help implement them but does not gate model construction. Do not launch a broad literature or proof campaign without a current decision it can resolve.

Use configurable training/context/evaluation windows and cumulative machine budgets with useful checkpoints and focused checks. Historical frozen stage gates, 15-minute limits and one-retry quotas do not govern new work. Open development evaluation may guide learning; final held-out assessment stays separate. This update does not promote prior evidence or claim alpha.

---

## Historical issue record — preserved in full

The original body below is retained verbatim. Its measurements, artifacts and experiment-specific decisions remain evidence at their stated scope. Earlier passages called current/next, blanket test bans, stage locks and broad mechanism demotions do not override the current owner-directed plan.

## Current role — nonblocking research reservoir (2026-09-04)

This issue is parked and unassigned. NEMESIS/W33 mapping is an on-demand donor activity under the canonical [architectural-alpha project track](https://github.com/UOR-Foundation/uor-r4/blob/main/docs/integration/project-track.md), not a prerequisite, proof gate, or compliance campaign between implementation stages.

Activate a bounded slice only when the current implementation has a concrete unresolved question and names the source object, proposed UOR seam, expected causal effect, and cheapest discriminating check. Inspect and attribute the original source, preserve its correction/proof status, keep H4/R4 distinct from other geometries, and measure any adopted mechanism in UOR before making a capability claim. The absence of a discovered NEMESIS reuse license still bars vendoring source material without permission; architectural study and attributed links remain allowed.

The current implementation stage after [PR #1120](https://github.com/UOR-Foundation/uor-r4/pull/1120) is sparse geometric attention. Work here does not block that stage. The original mapping scope is retained below as a research reservoir.

---

## Outcome
Promote directly relevant external mathematics into precise, attributable project hypotheses and candidate adapters rather than keyword-level association.

## Deliverable and DoD
Use pinned NEMESIS documents and W33 finite geometry/runtime/formal sources. State source object/domain, target R4 object/operator, map, composition/inverse/inner-product or invariance obligations, and a discriminating use case. Preserve the source's correction ledger and proof status. Scalar 256 values do not imply 256 geometric dimensions; F3 symplectic geometry is not automatically the current R4/H4 frame. No broad physics/complexity/proof transfer. NEMESIS lacks a discovered reuse license, so chronicle attributed notes/links until reuse permission is established.

## Ownership and next action
Planned research-transfer lane, unassigned after this adoption's relevance dossier. Next: choose the strongest finite mapping from that dossier and determine whether the needed bridge can be proved before modifying the current frozen mechanism. This does not block the unchanged construction exposure diagnostic.
